Shipping

All Orders are fulfilled and then shipped to anywhere in the United States in 1-3 working days on average.

Worldwide shipping (other than US) takes 4-8 working days depending on location:

  • Europe: 4-8 days
  • Australia: 4-8 days
  • United Kingdom: 4-8 days
  • Canada: 4-8 days
  • Rest of world: 4-8 days

All orders come with tracking information once shipped.

Returns

Not happy with your purchase? No worries, we've got you covered!

You may return it within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange, no questions asked. To initiate a return, just contact our customer service team at support@thefleececompany.com.

settings.text: Crafted from 100% muslin cotton, this Pajama set is naturally breathable and hypoallergenic, making it ideal for sensitive skin. The ultra-soft texture offers a gentle, comforting feel, while the lightweight weave ensures you stay cool and comfortable even on the warmest summer nights.

This pajama set features a relaxed short-sleeve top with a classic turn-down collar, paired with easy-fit shorts designed with a comfortable elastic waistband. Available in a range of calming pastel tones blush pink, lilac, mint, cream, and sky blue it brings both style and serenity to your sleepwear.
We won’t rest until you're completely happy with your Muslin Pajama Set.

I bought this pajama set for a summer trip, and I’ve barely taken it off since. The muslin cotton is unbelievably soft and airy. It feels like sleeping in a cloud. I’ll definitely be ordering another color!
